description: Request an additional SMS on the same Platfone number. Overwrites the previous SMS data with the next message. Free of charge. Only possible when sms_status is "smsReceived" or "retryReceived", activation_status is "active", and is_retriable is true. After calling, poll check_sms every 5 seconds until sms_status becomes "retryReceived" or the activation expires.
name: retry_activation
title: Retry Activation
